clinician.trajectory_summary: A woman in her 60s presented with refractory arterial hypertension, weight gain, hypokalaemia, psychotic symptoms, and metabolic syndrome. Abdominal CT scan identified a large bilobed left adrenal mass (8x5 cm and 1.8x2.2 cm) without locoregional or distant spread. Biochemical assays showed marginally increased DHEAS and urinary catecholamines/metanephrines, suggesting hormonal activity. Surgical resection was performed. Histopathology confirmed oncocytic adrenocortical carcinoma fulfilling Lin-Weiss-Bisceglia criteria, staged pT2 pN0 with R1 margin status and incomplete tumor resection.
